answer: Arrival-Jitter Fingerprint Gate. Each identity must submit its first 50 actions with inter-arrival timing drawn from a learned human-like distribution; agents whose timing is too regular are throttled to one action per hour. Attacker pays per-identity latency: forged jitter must be sampled, replayed, and maintained across a tundra of idle periods. A raven can mimic one rhythm, not thousands in parallel. Colluding farms must burn real wall-clock time per puppet, and dropping a dune of plausible timing seeds still fails the cross-correlation check against shared clock drift.
